summary: Frontend testing of (1) usuario access to CRM Cirugías, (2) Anesthesia monthly closure Excel/PDF export, (3) printable operative note. All requested flows pass. usuario sees nav-crm-cirugias, /crm-cirugias loads list + stats without redirect. Superadmin: /quirofano/anestesia Cierre mensual 2026-11 shows 6 procedimientos / Q2,200; Excel and PDF buttons visible+enabled, each triggered a real download (anestesia_2026-11.xlsx 5491 bytes, anestesia_2026-11.pdf 2413 bytes), API 200, success toasts 'XLSX descargado'/'PDF descargado'. Month 2026-01 -> both buttons disabled. Nota operatoria (Pacientes > historial of EXP-000017 Ana Morales, closed note): 'Imprimir' (nota-imprimir) visible next to 'Cerrada' badge; clicking opened a new window with formatted note (procedure, patient, date, eye, surgeon, institution, content, signature). No page/console errors.

minor.issue: num_registros = len(all records) includes records with anesthesiologist ''/N/A that are skipped in grouping. For 2026-11 header shows '6 procedimientos' but per-anesthesiologist breakdown sums to 5 (2+3). Same count is printed in the Excel/PDF header. Consider counting only payable records or showing 'N sin anestesiólogo'.

action_items: (Minor) Align num_registros with grouped records in _build_closure (routes/quirofano.py ~line 373) or show the excluded N/A count explicitly.
critical_code_review_comments: NotaCirugia.imprimir() interpolates estado.procedure/patient_name/surgeon/institution and contenido directly into document.write HTML without escaping - HTML injection risk in the print window (low risk, internal staff data). Escape plain-text fields.

Open-note print path not exercised in UI: the only 'abierta' note in preview belongs to an inactive patient (TEST_IGSS Paciente_CURL, is_active=false) so it is not reachable from Pacientes. Code renders the Imprimir button unconditionally in the header, and imprimir() reads editorRef innerHTML when editable, so it should work.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Operative notes live in Pacientes > historial button data-testid=evaluaciones-patient-{id} > nota-cirugia-item-{id} (EvaluacionesPacienteDialog), not in /sala-operaciones. Pacientes search requires clicking 'Buscar'; search by record number (EXP-000017) works. Anesthesia data in 2026-10/2026-11.
